t: 4-piece set comprising tools suitable for wire cutting, wire stripping, bolt cutting, crimping, reaming, and linesman/gripping. Manufactured from drop-forged chrome vanadium, with S2 steel shaft and sand-blasted tip for high performance, durability, and increased traction on screws. Black phosphate-coated for resistance to rust and corrosion, with colour-coded handles for easy identification. Features ergonomic, soft-grip handle for control and comfort, with integrated lanyard loop for safe working at height.
